dashboard.title: Accounting overview

ratios.title: Financial ratios
ratios.subtitle: Quick indicators from your books for analysis. Profit and loss is year-to-date; the balance sheet is as of the date below.
ratios.subtitlePortal: Summary indicators from your institution’s accounting records. Profit and loss is year-to-date; the balance sheet is as of the date below.
ratios.sparkHint: Each line shows the current ratio level versus a zero baseline (not a historical time series).
ratios.empty: Ratios will appear once you have posted balances (assets, revenue, or equity).
ratios.reportsLocked: Underlying detail is in your company’s financial reports (available to authorized staff).
